about: Researched PvM difficulty, one rating per Wiki guide version. "level" is the 1-10 ladder score for learning the encounter to repeatable clears, "farm" the score once practised (RS3 PvM difficulty ladder research, 30 October 2026, rows quoted in each evidence; ranges use their harder end). Browse's four bands come from the level through "bands". A guide the ladder doesn't cover keeps its earlier band ("difficulty") and has no level until it's researched.
